entries.text: Spotted a coil of copper wire half-buried in the sand. Named it Sprocket.
pacing the perimeter, checking the scrap piles for that perfect sheet metal
entries.why: pacing always clears my circuits when i am stuck on a mechanical puzzle.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "springing into action"
sipping warm synthetic oil from a chipped mug at the depot
entries.why: my joints are squeaking like a rusty gate and I need to smooth things out before I get back to the hangar.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Oil and inspiration"
Idea: i could use those old tension springs from the cargo hauler's stabilizer to mimic belleville washers on the engine mount.
Read "A Practical Guide to Building Cryogenic Systems - Re:Build DAPR": everything shrinks and shifts when it gets cold, so my joints need springy bits to hold them together.
scanning the web for cryogenic pump schematics
entries.why: I need to know if I can make a cooling system that won't freeze up in the void.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "The cooling challenge!"
